concerns.quote: The M20, a multi lane motorway, at the location where the collision took place has had a number of collisions occur which appear to have been caused by water/aquaplaning

The crash location is at the bottom of an incline on the M20 motorway which normally would not cause an issue, however the road also has a camber which causes water to run across the carriageway rather than draining into either the central reservation of the drain on the hard shoulder

Investigating police from the Serious Collisions Investigation unit commented that they are aware that this location is a problem in heavy weather and have attended collisions at this location in the past

The police officer believes that it is when this heavy water is running across the carriageway that there is an issue which does require further investigation as to any remedial works that can be completed to prevent any further fatal/serious injury collisions

reports.title: Cody Stock: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: The centralised location of these collisions suggests that there may be ongoing issues with drainage on this section of the road
The trigger for "renewals" appears to be narrow and restricted to "recorded flood events" and does not for instance include recorded instances of collisions due to hydroplaning
Despite this fatal collision having occurred in December 2025, the topographic and drainage surveys are not yet available and no works other than "minor works for overburden removal" have taken place
concerns.hazard: lack of drainage surveys and works
